fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Dense Vegetation; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure; Open Green Space
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Dense Vegetation; Limited Visibility; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clear sight lines for approaching emergency vehicles.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure to keep a clear path around all sides for responder movement.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of parked vehicles that could block emergency access to the main residence.
• Trim shrubs or trees that block visibility between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Post visible address or unit markers at the detached structure so responders can identify it as a separate building on arrival.
• Keep all walkway paths between structures clear of overgrowth to allow responders to move between buildings without obstruction.
• Identify and mark any secondary access points on the property so responders are aware of all available entry routes.

wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Large Trees; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Mixed Vegetation; Brush Area; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Open Terrain; Scattered Shrubs; Multiple Access Routes
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from large trees that hang directly over or touch any structure on the property.
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to structures so individual trees are not touching each other.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the base of any structure.
• Clear brush from the area immediately surrounding each structure, keeping the ground close to walls free of plant material.
• Separate scattered shrubs from scattered trees so there is open ground between them rather than a connected path of plants leading to a structure.
• Trim low branches from large trees up to a height that keeps them well clear of shrubs growing beneath them.
• Keep the mixed vegetation areas nearest to structures thinned so plants are spaced apart with bare ground visible between them.
• Mow or cut down tall grasses or low plant growth within the open terrain areas that sit between the brush area and any structure.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along their edges.
• Remove dead wood, fallen branches, and dry leaf litter from beneath trees near structures.
